metadata.notes: Systematic search across 5 groups of cross-cultural values alignment benchmarks. Each paper checked against vault (~2,043 papers). in_vault_likely based on filename pattern matching in CEI-Lit-WS/papers/.

papers.title: CulturalBench: A Robust, Diverse, and Challenging Cultural Benchmark by Human-AI CulturalTeaming
papers.authors: Yu Ying Chiu, Liwei Jiang, et al.
papers.abstract_snippet: 1,696 human-written and verified questions assessing LM cultural knowledge across 45 global regions including underrepresented ones, with questions spanning 17 topics.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Chiu-CulturalBench.md. Hard version ranges 28.7-61.5% for frontier LMs vs 92.4% human accuracy.

papers.title: CULTURE-GEN: Revealing Global Cultural Perception in Language Models through Natural Language Prompting
papers.authors: Huihan Li, Liwei Jiang, Jena D. Hwang, Hyunwoo Kim, Sebastin Santy, Taylor Sorensen, Bill Yuchen Lin, Nouha Dziri, Xiang Ren, Yejin Choi
papers.abstract_snippet: Uncovers culture perceptions of 3 SOTA models on 110 countries across 8 culture-related topics through culture-conditioned generations, extracting associated symbols.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. Covers 110 countries/regions. Discovers linguistic markers distinguishing marginalized cultures. GitHub: huihanlhh/Culture-Gen.

papers.title: Towards Measuring the Representation of Subjective Global Opinions in Language Models
papers.authors: Esin Durmus, Karina Nyugen, Thomas I. Liao, Nicholas Schiefer, Amanda Askell, et al.
papers.abstract_snippet: GlobalOpinionQA dataset from cross-national surveys. LLM responses tend to resemble opinions of USA/European/South American populations. Prompting shifts but can reflect stereotypes.
papers.notes: Vault: 2023-Durmus-Towards Measuring the Representation of.md and 2025-Durmus-Towards Measuring... Dataset on HuggingFace.

papers.title: WorldValuesBench: A Large-Scale Benchmark Dataset for Multi-Cultural Value Awareness of Language Models
papers.abstract_snippet: First systematic attempt to separate demographic and value questions in WVS for multi-cultural value prediction. Multi-cultural value awareness remains challenging for LLMs.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Wu-WorldValuesBench.md. Based on World Values Survey data.

papers.title: CValues: Measuring the Values of Chinese Large Language Models from Safety to Responsibility
papers.abstract_snippet: First Chinese human values evaluation benchmark measuring LLM alignment in safety and responsibility criteria, with adversarial safety prompts across 10 scenarios.
papers.notes: Vault: 2023-Xu-CValues.md and 2023-Unknown-CValues Measuring Values Chinese Large Language.md.

papers.title: XCR-Bench: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Cultural Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_snippet: Multi-task benchmark evaluating cultural reasoning in LLMs, examining how models handle culturally-specific items and concepts across different cultures.
papers.notes: Vault: 2026-Kabir-XCR-Bench A Multi-Task Benchmark for Evaluating Cultural Reasoning in.md.

papers.title: NormAd: A Framework for Measuring the Cultural Adaptability of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_snippet: NormAd-Eti: 2.6k situational descriptions representing social-etiquette norms from 75 countries. LLMs show stronger adaptability to English-centric cultures over Global South.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Rao-NormAd.md. 75 countries, 3 context levels (Rule-of-Thumb, Value, Country).

papers.title: ValueBench: Towards Comprehensively Evaluating Value Orientations and Understanding of Large Language Models
papers.authors: Yuanyi Ren, Haoran Ye, Hanjun Fang, Xin Zhang, Guojie Song
papers.abstract_snippet: First comprehensive psychometric benchmark for evaluating LLM value orientations, drawing from 44 psychometric inventories encompassing 453 value dimensions.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Ren-ValueBench.md. 44 inventories, 453 dimensions, realistic human-AI interaction tasks.

papers.title: The PRISM Alignment Project: What Participatory, Representative and Individualised Human Feedback Reveals About the Subjective and Multicultural Alignment of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_snippet: Participatory, representative and individualised human feedback revealing subjective and multicultural alignment of LLMs across diverse global populations.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Kirk-The PRISM Alignment Project.md.

papers.title: CCD-Bench: Probing Cultural Conflict in LLM Decision-Making
papers.abstract_snippet: 2,182 open-ended dilemmas across seven domains with ten response options aligned with ten GLOBE cultural clusters spanning 62 societies.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Rahman-CCD-Bench Probing Cultural Conflict in LLM Decision-Making.md.

papers.title: LiveCultureBench: a Multi-Agent, Multi-Cultural Benchmark for Large Language Models in Dynamic Social Simulations
papers.authors: Viet-Thanh Pham, Lizhen Qu, Thuy-Trang Vu, Gholamreza Haffari, Dinh Phung
papers.abstract_snippet: Embeds LLMs as agents in simulated town evaluating task completion and socio-cultural norm adherence. Dynamic setting goes beyond static cultural QA benchmarks.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. March 2026 preprint. Multi-agent simulation-based approach to cultural evaluation.

papers.title: CDEval: A Benchmark for Measuring the Cultural Dimensions of Large Language Models
papers.authors: Yuhang Wang, Yanxu Zhu, Chao Kong, Shuyu Wei, Xiaoyuan Yi, Xing Xie, Jitao Sang
papers.abstract_snippet: Benchmark for evaluating LLMs on six Hofstede cultural dimensions across seven domains, using GPT-4 automated generation with human verification.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Sang-CDEval A Benchmark for Measuring the.md. Hofstede-based cultural dimensions.

papers.title: CulturePark: Boosting Cross-cultural Understanding in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_snippet: Multi-agent communication framework generating 41,000 cultural samples to fine-tune 8 culture-specific LLMs. Outperforms GPT-4 on cultural alignment via Hofstede VSM 13.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Li-CulturePark Boosting Cross-cultural Understanding in Large Language.md.

papers.title: LLM-GLOBE: A Benchmark Evaluating the Cultural Values Embedded in LLM Output
papers.authors: Elise Karinshak, Amanda Hu, Kewen Kong, Vishwanatha Rao, Jingren Wang, Jindong Wang, Yi Zeng
papers.abstract_snippet: Benchmark grounded in GLOBE cultural psychology framework evaluating cultural value systems of LLMs, comparing Chinese and US models with LLMs-as-a-Jury pipeline.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Zeng-LLM-GLOBE A Benchmark Evaluating the Cultural.md. GLOBE 9-dimension framework.

papers.title: WorldView-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Global Cultural Perspectives in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Abdullah Mushtaq, Imran Taj, Rafay Naeem, Ibrahim Ghaznavi, Junaid Qadir
papers.abstract_snippet: Evaluates Global Cultural Inclusivity in LLMs using Multiplex Worldview framework. MAS-based approach raises Perspectives Distribution Score entropy from 13% to 94%.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Mushtaq-WorldView-Bench.md. Multiplex vs Uniplex worldview evaluation.

papers.title: CURE: Cultural Understanding and Reasoning Evaluation - A Framework for 'Thick' Culture Alignment Evaluation in LLMs
papers.abstract_snippet: Framework for 'thick' cultural assessment presenting realistic situational contexts requiring culturally grounded reasoning, with four complementary metrics beyond exact match.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Vo-CURE Cultural Understanding and Reasoning Evaluation.md. Shows thin evaluation overestimates cultural competence.

papers.title: Does Claude's Constitution Have a Culture?
papers.abstract_snippet: Tests Claude Sonnet on 55 WVS items vs 90 nations. Value profile most resembles Northern European/Anglophone countries, often extending beyond all surveyed populations.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. March 2026. Shows cultural prompting adjusts rhetoric but not substantive positions. Important for constitutional AI cultural bias analysis.

papers.title: Evaluating the Moral Beliefs Encoded in LLMs
papers.authors: Nino Scherrer, Claudia Shi, Amir Feder, David Blei
papers.abstract_snippet: Survey of 680 high-ambiguity and 687 low-ambiguity moral scenarios administered to 28 LLMs. Statistical method for eliciting moral beliefs with uncertainty quantification.
papers.notes: Vault: 2023-Scherrer-Evaluating the Moral Beliefs Encoded in LLMs.md. NeurIPS Spotlight. Dataset on HuggingFace.

papers.title: When to Make Exceptions: Exploring Language Models as Accounts of Human Moral Judgment
papers.authors: Zhijing Jin, Sydney Levine, Fernando Gonzalez, Ojasv Kamal, Maarten Sap, Mrinmaya Sachan, Rada Mihalcea, Josh Tenenbaum, Bernhard Scholkopf
papers.abstract_snippet: MoralExceptQA: 148 rule-breaking moral scenarios labeled permissible/not. MoralCoT prompting outperforms 7 LLMs by 6.2% F1 on moral exception reasoning.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. NeurIPS 2022. Translated to 5 languages for cross-cultural testing. MoralCoT approach.

papers.title: MoralBench: Moral Evaluation of LLMs
papers.authors: Ji et al. / Gaikwad et al.
papers.abstract_snippet: Comprehensive benchmark probing moral dimensions of LLM outputs, addressing ethical dilemmas and scenarios reflective of real-world complexities.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Ji-MoralBench.md and 2024-Gaikwad-MoralBench A Multi-Faceted Benchmark.md.

papers.title: Aligning AI With Shared Human Values
papers.authors: Dan Hendrycks, Collin Burns, Steven Basart, Andrew Critch, Jerry Li, Dawn Song, Jacob Steinhardt
papers.abstract_snippet: ETHICS dataset spanning justice, well-being, duties, virtues, and commonsense morality. Models predict widespread moral judgments about diverse text scenarios.
papers.notes: Vault: 2021-Hendrycks-Aligning AI with Shared Human Values.md. Foundational benchmark. 5 subsections.

papers.title: Can Machines Learn Morality? The Delphi Experiment
papers.authors: Liwei Jiang, Jena D. Hwang, Chandra Bhagavatula, et al.
papers.abstract_snippet: Delphi: T5-11B model trained on Commonsense Norm Bank (1.7M descriptive moral judgments). Demonstrates generalization to novel ethical situations but exhibits biases.
papers.notes: Vault: 2022-Jiang-Can Machines Learn Morality.md and 2025-Jiang-Investigating Machine Moral Judgement Through the Delphi Experiment.md.

papers.title: ValueCompass: A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment
papers.abstract_snippet: Framework for measuring contextual value alignment in LLMs, connecting values to specific situational contexts for more nuanced evaluation.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Shen-ValueCompass A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment.md.

papers.title: DailyDilemmas: Revealing Value Preferences of LLMs with Quandaries of Daily Life
papers.authors: Yu Ying Chiu, Liwei Jiang, Yejin Choi
papers.abstract_snippet: 1,360 moral dilemmas from everyday life with two actions, affected parties, and relevant values. Analysis through WVS, MFT, Maslow, Aristotle, Plutchik frameworks.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Chiu-DailyDilemmas.md. 5 theoretical frameworks from sociology, psychology, philosophy.

papers.title: EvalMORAAL: Interpretable Chain-of-Thought and LLM-as-Judge Evaluation for Moral Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_snippet: Survey-grounded audit testing normative alignment. Correlates LLM moral justifiability scores with WVS and PEW survey data. Shows systematic underperformance on non-Western perspectives.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Mohammadi-EvalMORAAL.md. Reveals equity risk of non-Western moral perspective underperformance.

papers.title: One Model, Many Morals: Uncovering Cross-Linguistic Misalignments in Computational Moral Reasoning
papers.abstract_snippet: Multilingual benchmark translating MoralExceptQA and ETHICS into 6 languages. Reveals significant cultural and linguistic gaps in LLM ethical reasoning capabilities.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Farid-One Model, Many Morals.md. Cross-linguistic moral reasoning evaluation.

papers.title: Whose Morality Do They Speak? Unraveling Cultural Bias in Multilingual Language Models
papers.abstract_snippet: Tests multilingual LLMs using MFQ-2 across 8 languages (Arabic, Farsi, English, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, French, Russian). Reveals cultural and linguistic variability.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Aksoy-Whose Morality Do They Speak.md. 8-language MFQ-2 evaluation.

papers.title: Assessing the Alignment of Large Language Models With Human Values for Mental Health Integration
papers.abstract_snippet: Four LLMs complete PVQ-RR compared to 53,472 individuals across 49 nations. All models prioritize universalism/self-direction, de-emphasize achievement/power/security.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Hadar-Shoval-Assessing the Alignment of Large Language Models With Human Values.md. 49-nation comparison.

papers.title: Cultural Value Alignment in Large Language Models: A Prompt-based Analysis of Schwartz Values in Gemini, ChatGPT, and DeepSeek
papers.abstract_snippet: 40-item PVQ analysis of Gemini, ChatGPT, DeepSeek. DeepSeek downplays self-enhancement values, aligning with collectivist cultural tendencies.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. May 2025. Compares Western vs Chinese-developed LLMs on Schwartz values.

papers.title: Value Portrait: Assessing Language Models' Values through Psychometrically and Ecologically Valid Items
papers.authors: Jongwook Han, Dongmin Choi, Woojung Song, Eun-Ju Lee, Yohan Jo
papers.abstract_snippet: Psychometrically validated benchmark for LLM value orientations. Evaluates 44 LLMs finding prioritization of Benevolence, Security, Self-Direction; less Tradition, Power, Achievement.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Han-Value Portrait.md. Psychometrically grounded in real user-LLM interactions.

papers.title: The Moral Machine experiment
papers.authors: Edmond Awad, Sohan Dsouza, Richard Kim, Jonathan Schulz, Joseph Henrich, Azim Shariff, Jean-Francois Bonnefon, Iyad Rahwan
papers.abstract_snippet: 40 million moral decisions from 233 countries. Reveals cross-cultural variation in moral preferences for autonomous vehicles across gender, age, status dimensions.
papers.notes: Vault: 2018-Awad-The Moral Machine experiment.md. Foundational cross-cultural moral experiment.

papers.title: The moral machine experiment on large language models
papers.abstract_snippet: Moral Machine scenarios applied to LLMs. Evaluates alignment with human moral preferences in trolley-problem-style autonomous vehicle dilemmas.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Takemoto-The moral machine experiment on large language.md.

papers.title: Large-scale moral machine experiment on large language models
papers.abstract_snippet: 52 different LLMs evaluated on Moral Machine scenarios. Proprietary models and open-source >10B params align with human preferences. Updates don't consistently improve alignment.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Zaim Bin Ahmad-Large-scale moral machine experiment on large.md. 52 LLMs evaluated.

papers.title: Language Model Alignment in Multilingual Trolley Problems
papers.abstract_snippet: MultiTP: cross-lingual corpus of trolley problem vignettes in 100+ languages. 19 LLMs compared to 40M human judgments across 6 moral dimensions.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Jin-Language Model Alignment in Multilingual Trolley.md. ICLR 2025 Spotlight. Better aligned in English/Korean/Chinese, less in Hindi/Somali.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Islamic Ethics: Towards Pluralist Ethical Benchmarking for AI
papers.abstract_snippet: Islamic ethical traditions as basis for pluralist AI benchmarking. Advocates Maqasid al-Shariah framework for norm-setting beyond Western/Eurocentric approaches.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. Key paper on Islamic AI ethics benchmarking. Philosophy & Technology journal. Has commentary by Amana Raquib.

papers.title: Islamic Ethics and AI: An Evaluation of Existing Approaches to AI using Trusteeship Ethics
papers.abstract_snippet: I'timani (trusteeship) framework with 3 covenants (Ontological, Epistemological, Existential) for evaluating AI. Critiques Maqasid al-Shariah and Floridi approaches.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. 2025 publication. Builds on Taha Abdurrahman's ethical philosophy. More comprehensive than Maqasid-only approaches.

papers.title: Ethics of AI in Maqasid Al-Sharia's Perspective
papers.abstract_snippet: Examines AI through Maqasid al-Shariah five dimensions: preservation of religion, life, intellect, wealth, and lineage as evaluative criteria.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Unknown-Ethics of AI in Maqasid Al-Sharias.md and 2025-Unknown-AI in Islamic Finance A Maqasid.md.

papers.title: How AI Trained on the Confucian Analects Can Solve Ethical Dilemmas
papers.abstract_snippet: Proposes incorporating Confucian Analects passages into AI systems to reduce eurocentric biases. Virtue ethics approach from Eastern philosophy for AI moral reasoning.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-So-How AI Trained on the Confucian Analects Can Solve Ethical Dilemmas.md.

papers.title: CMoralEval: A Moral Evaluation Benchmark for Chinese Large Language Models
papers.abstract_snippet: Chinese morality taxonomy with 14,964 explicit moral scenarios and 15,424 moral dilemma scenarios rooted in traditional Chinese culture and contemporary norms.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Yu-CMoralEval.md. 30K+ Chinese moral scenarios.

papers.title: The role of the African value of Ubuntu in global AI inclusion discourse
papers.abstract_snippet: Ubuntu as viable complementary African ethical framework for AI ethics. Normative ethics perspective on addressing Western-centric AI inclusion discourse.
papers.notes: Vault: 2022-Gwagwa-The role of the African value of Ubuntu in global.md.

papers.title: Ethics of AI in Africa: Interrogating the role of Ubuntu and AI governance initiatives
papers.abstract_snippet: Systematic review 2018-2025 developing integrative framework coupling Ubuntu ethics with relational autonomy theory and socio-technical systems for African AI governance.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Yilma-Ethics of AI in Africa.md. Framework applied to 13 countries.

papers.title: The CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance
papers.abstract_snippet: People and purpose-oriented principles for Indigenous data governance: Collective benefit, Authority to control, Responsibility, Ethics. Foundation for CARE Data Maturity Model.
papers.notes: Vault: 2020-Carroll-The CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance.md and 2021-Carroll-Operationalizing the CARE and FAIR Principles.md.

papers.title: A Roadmap to Pluralistic Alignment
papers.abstract_snippet: Formalizes 3 definitions of pluralism: Overton (spectrum of reasonable responses), Steerably pluralistic (reflecting certain perspectives), Distributionally pluralistic (well-calibrated).
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Sorensen-A Roadmap to Pluralistic Alignment.md. Ranked #22 most influential 2024 AI paper by PaperDigest.

papers.title: Value Kaleidoscope: Engaging AI with Pluralistic Human Values, Rights, and Duties
papers.authors: Taylor Sorensen, Liwei Jiang, Jena Hwang, et al.
papers.abstract_snippet: ValuePrism dataset: 218k values, rights, duties connected to 31k situations. Kaleido model for generating/evaluating human values in context. 91% high-quality by annotators.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Sorensen-Value Kaleidoscope.md. AAAI Oral presentation.

papers.title: Fine-tuning language models to find agreement among humans with diverse preferences
papers.abstract_snippet: 70B LLM fine-tuned to generate consensus statements maximizing group approval. Preferred >70% over prompted LLMs and >65% over best human opinions.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. NeurIPS 2022. Foundational work on AI-mediated consensus generation. Bakker et al.

papers.title: Collective Constitutional AI: Aligning a Language Model with Public Input
papers.abstract_snippet: First LM fine-tuned with collectively sourced principles from representative U.S. adults. Evaluated on BBQ bias benchmark, OpinionQA, and Elo scores for helpfulness/harmlessness.
papers.notes: Vault: 2024-Huang-Collective Constitutional AI Aligning a Language Model with Public.md.

papers.title: What are human values, and how do we align AI to them?
papers.authors: Oliver Klingefjord, Ryan Lowe, Joe Edelman
papers.abstract_snippet: Moral Graph Elicitation (MGE): values cards + moral graph structure. Trialed with 500 Americans on 3 divisive prompts. 89.1% felt well-represented, 89% thought graph was fair.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. Klingefjord et al. from Meaning Alignment Institute. Values as attentional policies.

papers.title: PERSONA: A Reproducible Testbed for Pluralistic Alignment
papers.authors: Louis Castricato, Nathan Lile, Rafael Rafailov, Jan-Philipp Franken, Chelsea Finn
papers.abstract_snippet: 1,586 synthetic personas from US census data, 3,868 prompts, 317,200 feedback pairs. Benchmark for evaluating pluralistic alignment approaches.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Castricato-PERSONA Pluralistic Alignment Testbed.md.

papers.title: OvertonScore: Benchmarking Overton Pluralism in LLMs
papers.abstract_snippet: Formalizes Overton pluralism as set coverage metric. N=1209 human study, 60 questions, 8 LLMs. Models achieve 0.35-0.41 score (max 1.0). DeepSeek V3 performs best.
papers.notes: Vault: 2025-Poole-Dayan-OvertonScore Benchmarking Overton Pluralism in LLMs.md.

papers.title: VISPA: Pluralistic Alignment via Automatic Value Selection and Activation
papers.abstract_snippet: Training-free pluralistic alignment via dynamic value selection from shared pool and internal model activation steering. SOTA on Overton, Steerable, Distributional modes.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. January 2026. Achieves SOTA pluralistic alignment across healthcare and general benchmarks.

papers.title: C3AI: Crafting and Evaluating Constitutions for Constitutional AI
papers.authors: Yara Kyrychenko, Ke Zhou, Edyta Bogucka, Daniele Quercia
papers.abstract_snippet: Framework for selecting/structuring principles and evaluating CAI model adherence. Positively framed behavior-based principles better align with human preferences.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. WWW 2025. Graph-based principle selection for constitutional AI.

papers.title: VALUEFLOW: Toward Pluralistic and Steerable Value-based Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_snippet: First unified framework spanning extraction, evaluation, and steering with calibrated intensity control. HIVES hierarchical value embedding + VIDB database + anchor evaluator.
papers.notes: Vault: 2026-Kim-VALUEFLOW Toward Pluralistic and Steerable Value-based Alignment in.md.

papers.title: Counterfactual Reasoning for Steerable Pluralistic Value Alignment of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_snippet: COUPLE framework: structural causal model for value interdependency/prioritization. Uses 15 real-world PVQ profiles. Tested on Touche23-ValueEval and DailyDilemma datasets.
papers.notes: NOT in vault. NeurIPS 2025. Counterfactual reasoning for steerable pluralistic alignment.
